root_causes.title: Missing reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase lacks a reproducible integration for the Infigraph CLI. The proposed solution introduces a dedicated wrapper to resolve, execute, and evaluate the availability of Infigraph capabilities.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a self-contained wrapper `scripts/kb/infigraph.py` that records resolution metadata, discovers the executable, and runs capability checks with strict timeout and JSON parsing. Create tests in `tests/kb/test_infigraph.py` using a fake executable.

tasks.title: Implement Infigraph CLI wrapper and capability checks
